howto.name: Upload your video
howto.text: Drag-and-drop MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, or M4V — up to 200 MB.

howto.name: Click Mute Video
howto.text: PrivaTools stream-copies the video and strips the audio track. Nothing is re-encoded, so it is lossless and quick.

faq.a: Yes. The video track is stream-copied without re-encoding, so its data is identical to the original; only the container is rewritten without the audio.
Yes, by the size of the audio track, which depends on the audio's bitrate and length. The video portion is unchanged.

faq.q: Can I just mute the audio instead of removing it?
faq.a: This tool removes the audio track entirely; it cannot put a silent track in its place. A video without an audio track simply plays silently.
